result.reason: Reading the exact command replaced one failed call with one documentation-read action, so it did not reduce task-specific actions. Existing JSON error plus documentation are sufficient; another mandatory pre-read would add policy overhead.
limitations: Cross-session comparison by the same agent is confounded by learning and order effects.
